description: This page provides a high-level overview of all engineering services offered by Hydrologic Innovation including hydraulic network modeling, WTP and STP design, GIS integration, and environmental consulting. Each service is summarized with a brief description and a link to its dedicated detail page, helping prospective clients identify the right solution for their project needs.
navigation_note: Accessible from the top navigation bar by clicking 'Services'. Also reachable from the homepage services overview section via 'Learn More' links and the hero CTA area.

list_of_sub_pages.description: This dedicated service page explains Hydrologic Innovation's expertise in hydraulic network modeling using industry-leading tools like WaterGems and SewerGems. It details the methodology, use cases for urban water distribution and sewer analysis, deliverables, and client benefits including pressure optimization and leak detection capabilities.
list_of_sub_pages.navigation_note: Opens when a visitor clicks the 'Hydraulic Network Modeling' service card or link on the main Services page. Back button or breadcrumb returns to the Services overview.

list_of_sub_pages.description: This service detail page covers Hydrologic Innovation's Water Treatment Plant design capabilities, outlining the engineering process from feasibility assessment through detailed design and compliance. It highlights design standards, technology integrations, past project scale, and the team's ability to deliver scalable, cost-effective WTP solutions for government and industrial clients.
list_of_sub_pages.navigation_note: Opens when a visitor clicks the 'Water Treatment Plant Design' service card or link on the main Services page. Back button or breadcrumb returns to the Services overview.

list_of_sub_pages.description: This service detail page describes Hydrologic Innovation's Sewage Treatment Plant design services, covering biological treatment processes, environmental compliance, effluent quality standards, and integration with existing infrastructure. Clients learn how the firm handles complex STP projects from concept through commissioning for municipalities and industrial facilities.
list_of_sub_pages.navigation_note: Opens when a visitor clicks the 'Sewage Treatment Plant Design' service card or link on the main Services page. Back button or breadcrumb returns to the Services overview.

list_of_sub_pages.description: This service detail page explains how Hydrologic Innovation leverages Geographic Information Systems to map, analyze, and manage water and sewer networks spatially. It covers data capture workflows, integration with hydraulic models, asset management, and how GIS-driven insights support data-driven infrastructure planning for government and utility clients.
list_of_sub_pages.navigation_note: Opens when a visitor clicks the 'GIS Integration' service card or link on the main Services page. Back button or breadcrumb returns to the Services overview.

list_of_sub_pages.description: This service detail page covers Hydrologic Innovation's environmental impact assessment and irrigation system consulting offerings. It details how the firm applies hydrological modeling, sustainability frameworks, and precision irrigation design to serve agricultural clients, real estate developers, and government bodies managing water resources and land development projects.
